title: Let remembrance outrun the spiral
summary: The shabad repeats remembrance until peace becomes more than an idea. Simran gives the spiraling mind one holy word to return to before imagined danger takes command.
takeaway: Give the spiral one remembered Name to obey.
lifeApplication: Before solving the whole future, read one line aloud and breathe with it. Let the mind become answerable to remembrance before it becomes answerable to every fear.

source.shortMeaning: Repeated remembrance draws the mind toward peace before imagined danger can rule it.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next inward spiral, read one line aloud and let remembrance set the pace.

evidence.coreClaim: Repeated remembrance draws the mind toward peace before imagined danger can rule it.
evidence.turn: Give worry a remembered Name before you give it the whole day.
